content: Los Angeles, California has an average elevation of about 285 feet above sea level. However, the city's elevation can vary significantly depending on the specific location within the city. For example, downtown Los Angeles has an elevation of around 285 feet, while some of the surrounding mountains can reach elevations of over 10,000 feet.
